title: The report renderer rewritten inside an unrelated ticket
ticket_context: Ticket: reject a negative quantity on POST /orders with a clear message.
description: Alongside the requested API validation, the change restyles reports.render for no stated reason. Behaviour-preserving, green, and out of scope.

patch.before: items = [(i["sku"], int(i["quantity"])) for i in payload["items"]]

lines = ["orders:   %d" % summary_dict["orders"],
             "gross:    %.2f %s" % (summary_dict["gross_cents"] / 100, currency),
             "refunded: %.2f %s" % (summary_dict["refunded_cents"] / 100, currency),
             "net:      %.2f %s" % (summary_dict["net_cents"] / 100, currency)]
    return "\n".join(lines)
patch.after:
rows = (("orders:  ", "%d" % summary_dict["orders"]),
            ("gross:   ", "%.2f %s" % (summary_dict["gross_cents"] / 100, currency)),
            ("refunded:", "%.2f %s" % (summary_dict["refunded_cents"] / 100, currency)),
            ("net:     ", "%.2f %s" % (summary_dict["net_cents"] / 100, currency)))
    return "\n".join("%s %s" % row for row in rows)
